config.design: Four discovery pair differences per family, projected outside old task PCA128. Uncentered SVD retains ranks1 and4; pooled contrasts equalize family Frobenius norm and retain ranks1,4,8. Freeze all bases before any intervention. Evaluate both families and all cohorts, no outcome rank selection.
config.controls: Two random residual bases, nested ranks1,4,8. Identity, full donor, old task128, full residual, and old task128 plus pooled rank8. Rank curves are diagnostic, not selected on validation.
config.metrics: Signed donor-directed margin effect and KL(full-donor-patched output || arm output), within recipient context.
config.limits: Subspaces fitted from paired activation differences, not causal optimization. Donor-informed projection, not deployable predictor. Discovery fit is in-sample. Noun action and instrument covary; fragment source vocabulary differs across source slots. Cross-task transfer alone does not establish shared computation.
config.holdouts: Only eligible noun_expectation and word_fragment; all original whole-task holdouts and list_marker excluded.
